top_signals.title: Bloomberg This Weekend 8/22/2026
top_signals.summary: The news doesn’t stop when markets close. Hosts David Gura, Christina Ruffini and Alexis Christoforous bring clarity, context and a bit of humor to the weekend’s biggest headlines, LIVE from New York. Joined by Former MI6 Chief Sir Richard Dearlove, American Whiskey Association President & CEO Michael Bilello, The Atlantic Contributing Writer and Columbia University Institute of Global Politics Distinguished Fellow Kim Ghattas, and Carleton College Professor of Economics and “Demographics and the Demand for Higher Education” Author Nathan Grawe. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Magnitude 5.9 earthquake rattles Tokyo and eastern Kanto region
top_signals.summary: Shaking registered lower 5 on Japan's seven-point seismic scale. There was no risk of a tsunami.
